categories.main_business_segments: Clean Harbors operates through two main business segments: (1) Environmental Services, which provides hazardous and non-hazardous waste management, industrial cleaning, field and emergency response, and related services; and (2) Safety-Kleen Sustainability Solutions, which focuses on used oil collection, re-refining, and the sale of recycled oil products and related automotive fluids.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced waste treatment technologies including high-temperature incineration, landfill disposal, wastewater treatment, solvent recovery, and recycling systems. In oil re-refining, proprietary processes convert collected used oil into high-quality base and blended lubricating oils, with continuous investment in automation, emissions control, and digital platforms for waste tracking and customer engagement.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Clean Harbors serves a diversified customer base across industries such as chemicals, general manufacturing, refineries, automotive, utilities, government, oil and gas, transportation, and retail. Customers range from small businesses to Fortune 500 companies, including public and private entities, with a significant presence in the industrial, commercial, and automotive sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in North America, with over 750 locations across all 50 U.S. states, nine Canadian provinces, Puerto Rico, and Mexico. In 2022, 87% of revenues were generated in the United States and 13% in Canada, with assets and facilities distributed across both countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Clean Harbors operates primarily in the downstream segment of the environmental services and oil recycling supply chain, providing end-to-end waste management, recycling, and product distribution directly to industrial, commercial, and automotive customers. The company also manages upstream collection of used oil and midstream processing through its network of facilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding service offerings and geographic footprint, cross-selling solutions, pursuing targeted acquisitions, investing in technology and automation, and supporting customers' sustainability goals. R&D and innovation focus on advanced waste destruction (e.g., PFAS incineration), emissions control, digital customer platforms, and development of sustainable products such as re-refined base oils.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through a mix of service fees for waste collection, treatment, and disposal; product sales of recycled and blended oils, lubricants, and automotive fluids; recurring service contracts (e.g., parts washer maintenance); and project-based industrial and emergency response services. The company benefits from recurring revenue streams and long-term customer relationships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Veolia North America, Harsco Corporation, Republic Services, Waste Management, Stericycle, Heritage-Crystal Clean, and various regional/local firms. Clean Harbors is positioned as the largest hazardous waste incinerator operator and used oil re-refiner in North America, with a broader service portfolio and geographic reach than any single competitor.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Clean Harbors reported $5.17 billion in revenues, up 35.8% from 2021, with Adjusted EBITDA of $1.02 billion (19.8% margin) and net income of $412 million. The company has demonstrated strong organic and acquisition-driven growth, robust cash flow generation, and ongoing investments in capacity and technology.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Clean Harbors differentiates itself through its comprehensive, integrated network of hazardous waste and oil recycling facilities, proprietary technologies, and ability to offer one-stop, sustainable solutions that help customers meet regulatory and ESG goals. The company emphasizes safety, compliance, reliability, and environmental stewardship, with unique capabilities in high-quality re-refined oil products and emergency response.
